Registered overloads instantiate serde_json::Value only; arbitrary Deserialize/Serialize derives require separately checked layouts. The Map/Number layout profile has no preserve_order or arbitrary_precision; float_roundtrip is a separate numeric-decoder capability. Value is an immutable checked recursive algebraic value, not an untyped JavaScript object; mutable borrows remain frontend obligations. Numbers preserve i64/u64 BigInt and finite binary64 independently; invalid typed values abort rather than being coerced to JSON null. Object keys follow Rust UTF-8 byte order, duplicate input keys retain their last value, and JSON strings contain Unicode scalar values. Rust differential execution remains gated on the full JavaScript checks; source-derived numeric and syntax fixtures do not establish whole-program parity.

items.name: updates_needing_ancestry
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn updates_needing_ancestry(
    updates: &[RefUpdate],
    policy: &crate::github_proxy::GitHubPolicy,
    repository: &crate::translation_core::Str,
) -> Vec<AncestryQuery> {
    updates
        .iter()
        .filter(|update| !update.is_create() && !update.is_delete())
        .filter(|update| !policy.allows_git_ref(repository, &update.name))
        .map(|update| AncestryQuery {
            name: update.name.clone(),
            old: update.old.clone(),
            new: update.new.clone(),
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn scope_admits(allowed_repositories: &[String], repository: &crate::translation_core::Str) -> bool {
    allowed_repositories.is_empty()
        || allowed_repositories
            .iter()
            .any(|allowed| allowed.eq_ignore_ascii_case(repository))
}
